name: Taylor Fritz
hometown: Rancho Santa Fe, California, United States
intro: Taylor Fritz is one of the top American men in tennis. He comes from sunny California. He is known for a booming serve and a rocket forehand.
story: His mom was a top-10 player. His dad was a pro and a coach. In 2024 Taylor reached the US Open final, right here in New York. He also won an Olympic bronze medal in doubles. This summer he won the big tournament in Washington, D.C.

funFacts.text: His mom, Kathy May, was a top-10 tennis player too.
He loves video games. He says gaming keeps his brain sharp for tennis.
He has a special Chipotle order with double chicken. He eats lots of protein.
He has a son named Jordan.
He was on the Netflix show Break Point.
He won an Olympic bronze medal in doubles in Paris in 2024.
He won the Washington, D.C. tournament in August 2026. It was his 11th trophy!

watchFor: Count his aces, the serves nobody even touches!
